I don't talk too much publicly about opposition teams and methods but all I've had from them for the game on Tuesday is they are very much settled and everything they are trying to do is very well, they've handled the squad well and gotten something out of them - we are lucky that is the case.
"They are very well organised and know what they are trying to do. We know we are as good a football team now as any in England plus we've added the two Dutch players.
"It would be great if we got through this tough period and into some better form. We tend to find our way at the business end of the season when other teams get weary.
